title: Concept: JupyterHub console is reachable without authentication
description: JupyterHub is an account-provisioning system: a successful login spawns a container with a shell, a home directory and often the cluster service-account token. A public hub therefore advertises a path to code execution that depends only on obtaining any account.
applicability: Responses that serve an administrative or diagnostic interface from a host reachable by ordinary users.
risk: The caller provisions a notebook server, explores mounts and, in a common configuration, reads the pod service-account token.
